context.transcript:
Hello, I own a jewelry store right by the History Museum, and visitors to the museum are always using my parking spaces.
I need a sign that lets people know the parking spaces are reserved for my customers.
Of course.
We offer a few standard signs that say no parking allowed, or we could customize a special sign for your business.
I don't want my customers to think they can't park beside the store, so I think a custom sign would be best.
But I'm worried that might be too expensive.
Well, it really depends on the template that you choose.
Why don't you go through our template selection in this book, and I'll tell you how much it'll be.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我在历史博物馆旁边开了一家珠宝店，博物馆的游客总是占用我的停车位。
我需要一个标牌，让人们知道这些停车位是为我的顾客保留的。
当然可以。
我们提供一些标准的“禁止停车”标牌，或者我们可以为您定制特殊的招牌。
我不希望我的顾客觉得他们不能停在店旁边，所以我认为定制的招牌最好。
但我担心那可能太贵了。
嗯，这真的取决于您选择的模板。
您可以在这本书里浏览我们的模板选择，我来告诉您费用是多少。
